title: Rerun, long window: both Bollinger studies (range-to-range A, level-arm retest B) on BTCUSDT SPOT 2017-08..2024-06, plus an OURS bear proxy

what.name: Rule
what.value_plain: same arms and parameters as the two originals; PRE_REG_LONG.md frozen first (12da8913a); ungated control = tagged events only
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Session-range tag, wide-band stratum, P40 proxy
what.value_plain: P40 = weekly RSI14 <= 40 alone, below SMA200; all OURS, never the trader's or Tom's
what.label: OURS

what.name: Regime mix
what.value_plain: 360 weeks long DEV (2017-08-07..2024-06-24): bull 73 (20%) | bear 0 (0%) | range 222 (62%) | n/a 65 (18%) | bear weeks: primary Malkan (weekly AND monthly <=40) 0, proxy P40 (weekly <=40 alone, below SMA200, OURS) 57
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Power gate
what.value_plain: prereg_gate (m 150): PASS only for the 6 A range cells; BLOCK for all 9 B range cells and all 18 P40 cells (BLOCKED_LONG.md)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Spot vs futures caveat
what.value_plain: spot, not futures; different series from the originals, so cells compare in size and sign, not bit for bit; the 2022-24 half was already seen, the new-data-only effect is not isolated; maintenance gaps not filled
what.label: OURS

how: Pooled Holm m = 30 over A range (6), B range (9), P40 (15); day-clustered 95 % CI; per-cell original vs long table in RESULT_LONG.md.
window: DEV 2017-08..2024-06 BTCUSDT SPOT klines (not futures, not spliced); data loaded only to 2024-07-01; VALIDATION not read (no DEV survivor); HOLDOUT never loaded

verdict.label: Verdict A (bb_range_to_range, powered family): FAIL again for the rule as encoded, now on 2017-08..2024-06 SPOT: 0 of 6 range cells have net > 0, all six nets are -0.115 to -0.165 % per trade with day-clustered CIs entirely below zero. Verdict B (bb_range_retest level arm) and every P40 bear-proxy cell: INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered), not FAIL: prereg_gate (m 150) BLOCKs all 9 B range cells and all 18 P40 cells (PASS only for the 6 A range cells, BLOCKED_LONG.md). 0 of 30 family cells survive; VALIDATION not read; HOLDOUT never loaded.

why: A, range gate, 15m, all sessions, signal entry: n 9008 / 1560 days net -0.128 % [-0.155, -0.102] (original n 4256, -0.130 % [-0.161, -0.099]); ungated tagged control n 12066 net -0.118 %; gate effect -0.010 % (t -1.4). The range gate still does nothing; A P40 cells net -0.110 to -0.148 %.

B level arm: 0 of 9 cells net > 0, nets -0.045 to -0.238 %; london k 1.0 n 413 net -0.238 % [-0.393, -0.084] (Holm 0.06). CIs wider than +-0.12 %, so a gross edge of 0.12-0.15 % is still not excluded.

B P40: the only positive nets in either study (asia k0.25 +0.083 % [-0.254, +0.419], n 105) all span zero, Holm p = 1.00. 0 survivors of 30. Not a PASS anywhere; the next step is more symbols or a different exit, each a new PRE_REG.
